schedule_task.title: Wake on a delivery [wizloop:webhook]
schedule_task.prompt:
[wizloop:webhook] A scheduled run of the loop file adapters/fixtures/t3/webhook.md. Do these steps in order. TIME below means the time now in UTC, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

1. Do this:
A delivery arrived for example-org/example-repo. Read its newest issue and label it.

2. Last, append `TIME webhook ok WHAT` to .openwiz/home/webhook/ok.log, where WHAT is one line saying what you did; or, if step 1 failed, `TIME webhook failed WHY`.
